items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I got his name on a record back there... I haven't been paid for it... I will if I take time.

ctx.x: But you said that you sent for him and then you and Henry Red stayed very close associates, right?
Yeah. He quit, I quit; I quit, he quit. He went with Mills' Blue Rhythm Band, he sent for me and I quit.
